title: Kern
description: One word set huge in Bricolage Grotesque and nothing else on the page, every letter a body tied to its neighbours by springs at the font's true kerning. It plucks itself on load; pull a letter and the line stretches like a ribbon, let go and it re-kerns, tap a letter or hold Shift for the heavy cut, type to set a new word.
intent: Make spacing physical: the optically correct spacing (the font's kerning plus the house tracking law) is the rest length of a spring chain, so stretching, morphing weight and width, and retyping all resolve back to perfectly set type.
sources: herb reference board: b091f70f Pinterest promo (giant grotesk, type as the subject)
